scope: Sixteen fixed new H2 observations compare EACH and GROUP predictions to exact nested joint reward/H1-contract distributions. Every ground H2 action is queried once; actual H1 boards share an oracle cache. This is an exact-support semantic check, not sampled learning, reduced candidate support or unrestricted planning.
ground_count_scope: Explicit state and swipe entry calls, step calls and returned outcomes are counted. Ground internal validation calls are not separately counted; their time is included in ground_seconds.
